card.name: Geography text: areas, borders, place names
card.fires_on: Digits inside area or elevation figures and partway through African or remote place names in geography descriptions. Also words in border directions such as 'to the East'.

modes.label: Digits in area/height figures
modes.description: A digit within a large number giving the area or height of a region or mountain.

modes.label: Inside place names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a rarely seen place name for a region or lake.

modes.label: Border directions
modes.description: Words in a description of neighbouring regions.
modes.example: it borders Somalia to<< the>> East, Wajir and Isi

card.writes: It seems to push toward more place names (Macedonia, Citadel) and away from tribe and warrior words.
card.plain: It marks numbers and names in descriptions of geographic regions, such as areas, borders and mountains.
